params.name: starting_from
params.description: Exclusive timestamp for filtering audit log entries by creation time.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Pagination direction. Accepted values are ASC and DESC.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of entries to return per page.

items.docs: Returns audit log events for the organization. Optionally filter by starting timestamp. Results are paginated by limit and ordered by sortOrder. Requires ORG_ADMIN role.
